paras: On Tuesday, about <r>16M USDT</r> flowed out of old deposit addresses at India's CoinDCX. A security researcher flagged it on X the next day.
CEO Sumit Gupta replied that the wallets were <u>not breached</u> and it "sounds like a false alarm".
On Sunday CoinDCX confirmed a <r>$16M loss</r> from wallets it had retired after its 2025 hack.
CoinDCX says a failed automatic "sweep" left deposits sitting in an old address, and that it <g>covered the loss itself</g>.
On-chain investigator ZachXBT says that address was still sweeping user deposits in <r>April and May 2026</r>, and told users to withdraw.
<u>Lesson: watch what an exchange does, not just what it says.</u>
